ops.title: cc-vigil hardware E2E acceptance run
ops.description: Human-run, on-hardware acceptance drills for cc-vigil that headless testing cannot cover (real SMAppService approvals, pmset/IOPM state, lid, battery, display, launchd recovery, real ~/.claude/settings.json). Full runbook lives in the cc-notes doc "cc-vigil hardware E2E playbook". Mark each criterion met/failed as you run it; closes when every drill passes. This is the remaining gate on the core acceptance task 25797dc.

ops.text: Drill 1 First-run install and approvals: after opening CCVigil.app, both the user LaunchAgent (daemon) and root LaunchDaemon (helper) are approved and running, cc-vigil status reaches the helper, the CLI symlink resolves into the app bundle, and settings.json holds 4 _cc_vigil hooks.
Drill 2 Idle baseline: with no claude process, within one idle poll (45s) pmset shows 0 cc-vigil assertions and SleepDisabled 0.

Drill 3 Issue-7: a run_in_background Bash outliving Stop keeps the block held (reason waiting) through the ~60s idle Notification with NO human-wait-hint discount; the parked-session contrast (no bg work) discounts within seconds; the hold releases when claude exits.

Drill 4 Display still sleeps: with a hold active the display sleeps on its own timer while the system stays up; pmset -g assertions shows only PreventUserIdleSystemSleep (no display assertion); the heartbeat file has no gap over 15s.

Drill 5 Lid-close clamshell: lid closed on AC with the hold active leaves no heartbeat gap across the closed-lid window; after releasing the hold, exactly one gap appears across a second closed-lid window.
Drill 6 Config fail-fast: batteryFloorPercent=99 makes the daemon refuse to start (out-of-range; allowed 5-50) while launchd keeps retrying, and cc-vigil status reports the daemon unreachable.

Drill 7 Battery-floor cutout: floor=50 with charge below it, unplugging AC latches cutout battery, releases the block (0 assertions, SleepDisabled 0) and blocks re-acquire while latched; replugging AC clears the cutout and the block re-applies.
Drill 8a kill -9 helper: the assertion returns to 1 and SleepDisabled 1 within ~15s via KeepAlive restart, init force-clear, and daemon re-push.
Drill 8b kill -9 daemon: the block never drops (helper holds assertion and pmset, dead-man armed but not fired); the hold survives the daemon restart with no flap.

Drill 8c dead-man: daemon disabled and SIGKILLed, the block persists ~60s then the helper force-clears (0 assertions, SleepDisabled 0) with self-healing retry until pmset confirms; recovers on re-enable.
Drill 8d graceful SIGTERM: the daemon pushes clear before exit within the 8s cap (SleepDisabled 0, 0 assertions, daemon-stopped logged); KeepAlive restarts it and the block returns within one poll.

Drill 9 hook idempotence: install-hooks over an installed settings.json is a no-op (empty diff, twice); uninstall-hooks removes every _cc_vigil entry while leaving user hooks verbatim; reinstall restores 4.
Drill 10 uninstall: the in-app uninstall removes hooks (0 _cc_vigil), unregisters both services, removes the CLI symlink, and leaves SleepDisabled 0 with no cc-vigil assertions.
